summary: Harden statistical reconstruction, validation, sensitivity analysis, and reporting against all audited failure modes.
changes: Quarantine materially asymmetric confidence intervals and suppress unsupported reconstructed p-values while retaining explicit diagnostics.
Require a complete published-result reproduction gate before sensitivity analyses and enforce canonical dependence states inside the synthesis engine.
Use current Cochrane and Review Manager prediction-interval behavior by default while retaining the historical k-2 convention as an explicit option.
Keep cumulative sensitivity populations stable, separate inventory integrity from included-pool validity, validate output confidence, and label the Q-based I-squared method.
Correct exact NNT and NNH rounding, forest-plot weights and row alignment, very small p-values, and source-interval documentation.
Treat only a missing top-level SciPy package as optional absence; propagate broken internal SciPy imports and calculation failures.
